reason: I'd use the free first visit and, if it's good, bring my group on a weekday Group Morning at $8 a kid. I would not pay $15 a visit on my own.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? $15 a kid is a lot on $40k when we're already juggling shifts and bills.
would_change_my_mind: Drop-in closer to $10, or the group rate also working for smaller groups of 3 families and on afternoons that fit around hospital shifts.
